name: tweetly
description: Multi-tenant X (Twitter) automation platform with MCP and REST API. Bring your own AI; Tweetly handles browser-driven actions.
author: Furkan Beydemir <furkanbeydemirr@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test:unit && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
